import (
	"os"
	"testing"

	"cuelang.org/go/cue/cuecontext"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestValidate_Success(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("fixtures/valid.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	cctx := cuecontext.New()

	err = validate(b, cctx)

	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestValidate_Failure(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("fixtures/invalid.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, err)

	cctx := cuecontext.New()

	err = validate(b, cctx)
	require.EqualError(t, err, "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout: invalid value 110 (out of bound <=100)")
}

package cue

import (
	\"bytes\"
	\"encoding/json\"
	\"errors\"
	\"os\"
	\"path/filepath\"
	\"strings\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestValidate_Success(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(\"fixtures/valid.yaml\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	validator, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result, err := validator.Validate(\"valid.yaml\", b)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, result.Errors)
}

func TestValidate_Failure(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(\"fixtures/invalid.yaml\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	validator, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result, err := validator.Validate(\"invalid.yaml\", b)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Equal(t, []Error{{Path: \"flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout\", Message: \"invalid value 110 (out of bound <=100)\", Location: Location{File: \"invalid.yaml\", Line: 16, Column: 16}}}, result.Errors)
}

func TestValidate_MultipleFieldErrors(t *testing.T) {
	const input = "'`flags:
- key: demo
  name: Demo
  enabled: true
  variants: []
  rules:
  - segment: users
    rank: 1
    distributions:
    - variant: a
      rollout: 110
  nabled: true
  escription: typo
segments: []
`
	validator, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result, err := validator.Validate("mistakes.yaml", []byte(input))
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 3)
	byPath := map[string]Error{}
	for _, issue := range result.Errors {
		byPath[issue.Path] = issue
	}
	require.Equal(t, Location{File: "mistakes.yaml", Line: 11, Column: 16}, byPath["flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout"].Location)
	require.Contains(t, byPath["flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout"].Message, "<=100")
	require.Equal(t, Location{File: "mistakes.yaml", Line: 12, Column: 3}, byPath["flags.0.nabled"].Location)
	require.Equal(t, Location{File: "mistakes.yaml", Line: 13, Column: 3}, byPath["flags.0.escription"].Location)
	require.Contains(t, byPath["flags.0.nabled"].Message, "field not allowed")
}

func TestValidateFiles_Formats(t *testing.T) {
	file := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "bad.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(file, []byte("flags: []'"\\nsegments: []\\nwrong: true\\n\"), 0600))
	for _, format := range []string{\"text\", \"json\"} {
		t.Run(format, func(t *testing.T) {
			var out bytes.Buffer
			err := ValidateFiles(&out, []string{file}, format)
			require.True(t, errors.Is(err, ErrValidationFailed))
			if format == \"text\" {
				require.Contains(t, out.String(), file+\":3:1: wrong: field not allowed\")
			} else {
				var result Result
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &result))
				require.Equal(t, Error{Path: \"wrong\", Message: \"field not allowed\", Location: Location{File: file, Line: 3, Column: 1}}, result.Errors[0])
			}
		})
	}
	var out bytes.Buffer
	require.ErrorContains(t, ValidateFiles(&out, []string{file}, \"xml\"), \"invalid validation format\")
	require.True(t, strings.Contains(out.String(), \"\") )
}
EOF
